plan.goal: Create GitHub release v4.13.12 for honojs/hono repository, upgrading from v4.13.11

steps.title: Analyze commits between v4.13.11 and v4.13.12
steps.detail: Review git log and commit history between v4.13.11 and v4.13.12 to identify all changes, bug fixes, features, and breaking changes for the release notes

steps.title: Check dependencies and security updates
steps.detail: Verify if any dependencies were updated between versions and check for any security advisories that need to be mentioned

steps.title: Draft release notes
steps.detail: Compose comprehensive release notes including summary of changes, new features, bug fixes, breaking changes (if any), and dependency updates for v4.13.12

steps.title: Update CHANGELOG.md
steps.detail: Add entry for v4.13.12 to CHANGELOG.md with the version number, release date, and summary of changes

steps.title: Validate release artifacts
steps.detail: Verify that all build artifacts are present and correct, including compiled JavaScript, TypeScript definitions, and any bundled files

steps.title: Test installation and basic functionality
steps.detail: Install the package from the tagged release and run basic sanity checks to ensure the release is properly packaged and functional

steps.title: Prepare release announcement
steps.detail: Create a concise announcement for social media and community channels highlighting key improvements and changes in v4.13.12

steps.title: Coordinate release publication
steps.detail: Ensure all steps are complete, trigger npm package publication, create GitHub release with notes, and coordinate announcement across channels

risks: Incomplete commit analysis leading to missing changes in release notes
Forgotten dependency updates not documented in release notes
Artifacts not properly built or packaged before release
Installation or functionality issues discovered after publishing
Release notes containing sensitive information or incomplete details

officialRelease.name: v4.13.12
officialRelease.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(build): keep internal types private in bundled d.ts and avoid a self-referencing JSX.IntrinsicElements in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5485
* test(build): type-check the bundled declarations from a consumer project in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5486
* fix(etag): correctly match mixed-case header name in retainedHeader option in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5475
* fix(jsx): add px to numeric gridGap, gridRowGap and gridColumnGap in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5487
* fix(combine): return a Response from a short-circuiting middleware in some() in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5391
* chore(deps): upgrade vite-plus to 1.0.0 in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5464

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/honojs/hono/compare/v4.13.11...v4.13.12
